Subject: Decision Readout + Security & Procurement Checkpoints

Hi Priya / Ethan —

Thanks again for your time on today’s demo. Quick recap and a concise set of next steps so we’re all aligned on the buying path at Novum Health. I’ve captured the decision drivers we heard and the current open asks from your side.

Key decision drivers (as discussed)
- Integration risk: SSO, audit logs, and data residency expectations for PHI-adjacent telemetry.
- Cost predictability: committed throughput vs burst pricing for peak call volume.
- Output fidelity & safety: controlled generation filters for patient-facing content.

Stakeholder map (please confirm names/owners)
- Economic buyer: Priya Menon (Confirmed in meeting)
- Security review: Ethan Moore + LegalOps (security questionnaire in flight)
- Procurement/Contracts: TBD (you mentioned central procurement team)
- Engineering champion: Dr. Anika Shah (demo attendee)

Open asks from Novum Health
1) Completed security questionnaire (you indicated ~48–72 hours to return).
2) List of required contractual clauses & procurement timeline.
3) Confirmation on SOC 2 report scope (expected in RFP).

What Redwood will deliver by our next checkpoint (I’ll send these today)
- Updated evaluation deck with cost scenarios for committed vs burst capacity (see attached redwood-eval-deck.pdf).
- Security FAQ table and a filled copy of your questionnaire template to speed the sec review (attached: novum-security-qa.xlsx).
- Procurement checklist outlining typical contract path, required documents, and a suggested playbook for a 60–90 day procurement window (attached: procurement-checklist.docx).

Proposed next steps / dates
- Priya: confirm procurement contact and target procurement window by Mon 2028-03-13.
- Novum SecOps: return questionnaire by Fri 2028-03-11.
- Redwood (Marissa): prep contract sketch and pricing appendix by Tue 2028-03-14.
- Follow up alignment call (30m) week of 2028-03-20 to review sec responses and initial contract items.

If the procurement timeline is shorter/longer, flag that and we’ll compress/expand milestones accordingly.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez

sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Sergio —

Thanks for the clear summary and the materials. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement contact: I’m looping in our procurement lead, Jordan Patel (jordan.patel@novumhealth.com). Jordan will own the contract timeline; his expected window today is 45–60 days given internal SaaS procurements.

2) Security questionnaire: we’ve started the questionnaire; ETA to share is Friday 2028-03-11 EOD. LegalOps will add a few contract redlines related to indemnity and data processing.

3) Economic decision: I will be the final approver, but the exec sponsor is Dr. Leena Raman (VP Clinical Ops). Dr. Raman would like an ROI sketch tied to throughput assumptions before final sign-off.

4) SOC 2: we expect a vendor SOC 2 type II report; can you confirm whether Redwood will share the latest report and the scope (production only vs staging included)?

We also had a question on model change controls — is there a standard Redwood process for notifying customers of model upgrades or quality regressions? If you can include that in the security FAQ that’d be ideal.

I’ll coordinate with Jordan and LegalOps on timing.

Thanks,
Priya Menon
Head of Product Operations | Novum Health
